request_scope.covered: Every change is in the proposal (sections 1, 2, 3a, 3b, 3c) except one, the addition below.

addition_of_the_same_kind.old: - Out: running the evals, giving the verdict, writing the handoff plan, and checking the code against the project's standards. Code → Validation owns them, through Test with evals the builder never sees and Validate its own code.

addition_of_the_same_kind.why: Added after the proposal was shown: the page still named "Validate its own code", the name the product owner replaced; the same kind of change as the 2 BI-3 lines of proposal section 3b. "Test with evals the builder never sees" on the same line is left as it is, as proposal section 4 says.

request_scope.note: Proposal section 3a calls the 22 pages that quote BI-4's Must not "the six BI-4 capabilities and their features"; 17 are BI-4 pages and 5 are BI-3 pages (Build the work test first, its 2 features, Fix defects test first and its feature) that quote the same line. The count, 22, is the one the product owner approved.
